command:
bash -lc '
set -u
LOCK=/tmp/c720p-job-990019.lock
mkdir "$LOCK" 2>/dev/null || exit 0
BASE=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JesperOaths/kale-nel/main/ops/c720p
OUT=/tmp/c720p-v865a-990019.out
: > "$OUT"
runstep(){
  name="$1"; url="$2"
  echo "STEP=$name" >> "$OUT"
  if curl -fsSL --max-time 30 "$url" -o "/tmp/$name.py"; then
    python3 "/tmp/$name.py" >> "$OUT" 2>&1
    rc=$?
    echo "RC_$name=$rc" >> "$OUT"
    return $rc
  else
    echo "RC_$name=curl_failed" >> "$OUT"
    return 90
  fi
}
runstep install-google-oauth-ui-v865 "$BASE/install-google-oauth-ui-v865.py" || true
runstep patch-drive-archive-v865 "$BASE/patch-drive-archive-v865.py" || true
runstep hide-s3-controls-v865 "$BASE/hide-s3-controls-v865.py" || true
systemctl --user disable --now c720p-frontyard-security.service >> "$OUT" 2>&1 || true
sleep 3
OAUTH_CODE=$(curl -sS -o /tmp/oauth-body -w "%{http_code}" --max-time 5 http://127.0.0.1:8796/ 2>>"$OUT" || true)
OAUTH_TITLE=$(grep -o "C720P Google OAuth Repair" /tmp/oauth-body 2>/dev/null | head -1 || true)
echo "OAUTH_HTTP=$OAUTH_CODE" >> "$OUT"
echo "OAUTH_TITLE=$OAUTH_TITLE" >> "$OUT"
PLAYBACK=skipped
if curl -fsSL --max-time 30 "$BASE/test-drive-playback-v865.py" -o /tmp/test-drive-playback-v865.py; then
  PLAYBACK=$(python3 /tmp/test-drive-playback-v865.py 2>&1 | tail -c 1800)
fi
echo "PLAYBACK=$PLAYBACK" >> "$OUT"
python3 - <<'"'"'PY'"'"'
import json,pathlib,urllib.request,time
out=pathlib.Path('/tmp/c720p-v865a-990019.out').read_text(errors='ignore')[-6000:]
token=pathlib.Path('/home/jespern/.config/c720p-agent/security-token').read_text().strip()
payload={'observed_at':time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ',time.gmtime()),'maintenance':{'v865a_job_990019':{'ok':('OAUTH_HTTP=200' in out and 'C720P Google OAuth Repair' in out),'output':out}}}
req=urllib.request.Request('https://uiqntazgnrxwliaidkmy.supabase.co/functions/v1/c720p-security-control?action=health',data=json.dumps(payload,separators=(',',':')).encode(),method='POST',headers={'content-type':'application/json','x-c720p-token':token})
try:
  r=urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=15); print('HEALTH_POST',r.status); r.close()
except Exception as e:
  print('HEALTH_POST_ERR',type(e).__name__,str(e)[:200])
PY
cat "$OUT"
'
